decisions.reason: A navigation and observation camera close to the core offer, presented on its own page in both years, reflects sunk space-qualification investment and visible commitment, so management will persist with it.
The modular camera line has proven itself on ESA's HERA mission, which publicly validates the investment and makes it central to the firm's announced direction.
The space situational awareness suite fits the firm's announced expansion into observation applications, and slow uptake in a long-cycle market can still be attributed to temporary causes.
Despite only being mentioned on the website, the miniaturized LiDAR embodies the strategic push toward compact sensors for smaller satellites, and its heavy development costs encourage persistence.
The recently launched radiation-hard camera line, presented on its own page and close to the core business, has had too little time to disappoint, and its qualification investment is substantial.
The asteroid navigation camera builds on the visible HERA heritage, so the firm will keep it to leverage that public mission success even though it is only mentioned on the website.
